title: Clubkonnect vs Ufriends IT — Full VTU & Identity Services Comparison
excerpt: Clubkonnect and Ufriends IT are both popular Nigerian VTU platforms. This comparison covers pricing, services, NIN/BVN features, API tools, and which platform gives you better value.

sections.content: Clubkonnect has been one of the most recognized names in Nigeria's VTU space for years. It is known for competitive reseller pricing, recharge card printing, and a wide range of digital services. Ufriends IT is a newer platform that combines traditional VTU services with government identity features like NIN/BVN slip printing and modification. In this comparison, we will look at what each platform does well, where they fall short, and which one makes more sense for different types of users.
Whether you are a reseller, a developer, or just someone who wants to buy cheap data and handle NIN issues from one place, this article gives you the full picture without the marketing talk.
Quick Summary

Clubkonnect is a strong VTU platform with years of track record, great reseller discounts, and a popular referral program. Ufriends IT matches Clubkonnect on core VTU services and adds NIN/BVN slip printing, identity modification, BVN retrieval, and CAC registration on top. If you only need data and airtime, Clubkonnect is a proven choice. If you need VTU plus identity services, Ufriends IT covers more ground.
Clubkonnect Overview

Clubkonnect (clubkonnect.com), operated by Nellobyte Systems Limited, is one of the most established VTU platforms in Nigeria. It offers instant airtime and data for all networks, cable TV subscriptions (DStv, GOtv, Startimes), electricity bill payments, exam pins (WAEC, NECO, NABTEB, JAMB), recharge card printing, bulk SMS, and developer API access. Clubkonnect is well known for its discounted pricing model where registered users pay less than face value. The platform has both a website and mobile apps on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Its referral program lets users earn commissions on signups.
Ufriends IT Overview

Ufriends IT (ufriends.com.ng) combines VTU services with government identity features. On the VTU side, it offers data, airtime, cable TV, electricity, exam pins, airtime-to-cash, and bulk SMS at wholesale pricing. On the identity side, it provides NIN slip printing in four formats (Regular, Standard, Premium, VNIN), BVN slip generation, lawful BVN and NIN modification, BVN retrieval using phone numbers, and CAC business registration. The platform includes a Developer API v1 with Sandbox Mode, Node.js/PHP SDKs, and automated webhooks. Wallet funding uses dedicated virtual bank accounts.
Side-by-Side Feature Table
Pricing and Value Comparison

Clubkonnect has built its reputation on competitive reseller pricing. Users pay less than the face value of services, and the platform adjusts rates based on market conditions. Their pricing is transparent within the dashboard and app. Ufriends IT follows a similar wholesale pricing model with multiple account tiers offering better rates. Both platforms are competitive on data and airtime pricing.

Where the value equation shifts is in the additional services. Clubkonnect offers recharge card printing — useful for vendors who sell scratch cards. Ufriends IT offers identity services — useful for anyone who needs NIN/BVN documents. Both are valuable, but identity services tend to be needed more frequently by more people in Nigeria.
NIN and BVN Services

Clubkonnect does not offer any NIN or BVN services. It is purely a VTU and utility payment platform. If you need to print your NIN slip, correct a wrong name on your BVN, retrieve a lost BVN, or generate a BVN slip for a bank requirement, Clubkonnect cannot help you.

Ufriends IT provides comprehensive identity services: instant NIN slip printing (choose from Regular, Standard, Premium, or VNIN), BVN slip generation in regular and premium plastic card formats, lawful NIN modification (name, date of birth, phone number), lawful BVN modification (name, date of birth, phone number, or any combination), BVN retrieval using your registered phone number, and CAC business name registration. All of this is accessible from the same dashboard where you buy data.
Reseller and API Features

Clubkonnect is a popular choice among resellers because of its established discount tiers and referral commission program. The API covers data, airtime, cable TV, and electricity transactions. Ufriends IT's Developer API v1 goes further with a Sandbox Mode (test without spending real money), official Node.js and PHP SDKs, and automated webhook notifications. If you are building a fintech app or a custom VTU portal, Ufriends IT's developer tools give you more to work with.
Customer Experience

Clubkonnect has native mobile apps on both Android and iOS, which many users prefer for daily transactions. Their interface is clean and well-tested over years of use. Ufriends IT uses a responsive web app (PWA) that works on all devices when added to the home screen. Both platforms offer customer support through WhatsApp and standard channels. Clubkonnect benefits from years of community building and a strong social media presence. Ufriends IT is building its reputation on the unique combination of services it offers.
Pros and Cons
Clubkonnect

items: ✅ Established platform with years of trust
❌ API lacks sandbox mode and SDKs

sections.content: Ufriends IT

items: ✅ NIN slip printing (4 formats) and BVN slip generation
✅ Full Developer API with Sandbox, SDKs, webhooks

sections.content: Final Verdict

Clubkonnect is a tried-and-tested VTU platform. If you have been using it and only need data, airtime, and bill payments, there is no urgency to switch. But if you are choosing a platform for the first time, or if you need NIN/BVN services alongside your VTU transactions, Ufriends IT offers a more complete package. The ability to buy data, print NIN slips, modify BVN details, and register a business from one wallet is a genuine advantage that no pure VTU platform can match.
Try Ufriends IT free at ufriends.com.ng — buy cheap data and print your NIN/BVN slip from the same dashboard.
Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: Is Clubkonnect better than Ufriends IT for data reselling?
items.a: Both platforms offer competitive reseller pricing. Clubkonnect has a longer track record and stronger community, while Ufriends IT provides similar data rates plus additional identity services. For pure data reselling, both work well.

items.q: Can Clubkonnect print NIN or BVN slips?
items.a: No. Clubkonnect is a VTU and utility payment platform only. It does not offer NIN slip printing, BVN slip generation, or any identity modification services. For these, you would need Ufriends IT.

items.q: Does Clubkonnect have a referral program?
items.a: Yes. Clubkonnect offers a referral program where users earn commissions when people they refer make transactions. Ufriends IT also has a referral program with bonus incentives.

items.q: Which platform has better developer tools?
items.a: Ufriends IT offers a more complete developer experience with API v1, Sandbox Mode, Node.js and PHP SDKs, and automated webhooks. Clubkonnect provides standard API access without sandbox or SDK support.

items.q: Can I convert airtime to cash on Clubkonnect?
items.a: As of our research, Clubkonnect does not offer airtime-to-cash conversion. Ufriends IT supports this feature, allowing you to convert excess airtime from MTN, Airtel, and Glo back into your wallet balance.

items.q: Should I switch from Clubkonnect to Ufriends IT?
items.a: If you need NIN/BVN services and identity document management alongside your VTU transactions, switching makes sense. If you only need data and airtime, Clubkonnect continues to work fine. You can also use both platforms side by side.
